title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at RAC (Perth, Northern Suburbs & Joondalup; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). We are currently seeking an innovative and creative Business Analyst to support the Motoring Division to achieve business goals as outlined in the business strategy. What will you be doing? Utilising your excellent relationship management at all levels, you will be working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders. Responsibilities include: Analysis and solution definition Business case development Making recommendations Performing testing and providing evaluations Project management and execution Along with the above you will facilitate meetings and training and implement change management initiatives. Reporting to the Projects & Analysis Manager, this position is a full-time opportunity for a 6 month maximum term contract. What are we looking for? To secure this role you will have previous experience in all facets of a business analyst role in a project, operational and business improvement environment. Your strong computer literacy, experience developing and producing business cases and cost benefit analyses combined with your proven written and verbal communication skills will afford every opportunity to succeed in this diverse and rewarding role. Demonstrated experience building positive relationships along with the ability to work autonomously as well as part of a team is critical to the success of this role, as is the ability to confidently present and facilitate one on one meetings and group workshops. Knowledge of and experience using Lean Six Sigma techniques, along with experience using Microsoft Office (with a particular focus on Microsoft Excel at an advanced level) and Business Process Management software. We are looking for an enthusiastic individual who will thrive in a culture of continuous improvement. For you to be considered, please upload your cover letter and resume showcasing what you can bring to the team. If you are shortlisted, you will be invited to complete an online automated video interview as part of our screening process. For further information or a confidential conversation about this vacancy, please contact Claire Douglas, Talent Acquisition Partner on 9436 4906. About RAC RAC is one of Western Australia’s most trusted brands and has been a part of the WA community since 1905. From our origins as a motoring club, we have grown to an organisation of over 1400 employees serving more than 1 million members with a diverse range of products and services. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, RAC encourages applications from all cultures, genders and abilities. At RAC we innovate and craft, advocate and campaign, challenge and reinvent. We want to be WA’s most valued organisation and our people are at the centre of this. We need people who want a career not just a job. We want motivated people who see the bigger picture and strive to make things better for our members and WA. If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you.
